notes: Design fidelity is still strong. The surfaces are near-black (#121212/#181818/#1f1f1f), there is one #1ed760 accent, buttons and chips are 9999px pills with uppercase 1.4px labels, badges are compact, and type stays between 10 and 24px. The settled badge and the nav count no longer use green as a background; the green brand dot is allowed by DESIGN.md. Typecheck and lint pass. Of the 16 earlier findings, these are fixed: the wizard's day clock (a tour booked in one go reads Day 1/3/6, as the 7-booked-dashboard shot shows); the dead 'Explore the demo band' button on /tour; Activity scoped to the band's own shows; the 'auto-pilot' label on the band's own tour; the show page's validator wording and its sticky error; .table-wrap on the tickets table; and venue-keys caching a bad response. The booked dashboard is clear: the attention line says '1 of 3 shows wait for their venue to sign', there are live steps (Route OK, Venues signed, On sale, Confirmed, Settled), and each card shows sold/need, its deadline and its state. The fixes add new bugs, though. (1) On GitHub Pages the guest demo band is merged with its live devnet tour, and fetchLiveTour sets cluster 'live', so the recorded demo reads 'booked by you'. It also loses the Offers and Venues OK steps, the 'Recorded run' note and its transcript feed, and its replacement shows lose their replaces/replacedBy links and get day numbers in the 80s (their dates are about 160 s later on chain). (2) The show page looks a show up in the bundled demo band's tour, not the show's own band, so a show the band booked itself has a truncated address as its title, with no city and no day. (3) 'Finish booking' recomputes dates from a new now, so resumed shows land hundreds of 'days' after the first ones. (4) The scoped feed still never names the city in sale, confirm, cancel, refund or payout events. fetchShowEvents swallows RPC errors, so a rate-limited devnet reads 'nothing else has happened yet', even next to cards with 16 sold. Still open: no 'demo clock' cue beside the Nov dates and second-level countdowns; no reason given when a wallet that holds a ticket cannot buy again; the 15,000 px phone venues page; the unshipped font; the bare 'Waiting for devnet…' state in the wizard. The UI bot still has no show-page shot and no populated phone dashboard.
issues: packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:46-51,150 with lib/chain-live.ts:96: in static mode the demo band's bundled run is spread with fetchLiveTour's result, and live.cluster='live' overrides the bundle's cluster. On Pages, guest mode then reads 'booked by you', switches to the 5-step live stepper, hides 'Recorded run' and swaps the recorded transcript for the chain feed. The live shows also replace the bundled ones, dropping replaces/replacedBy and giving replacements days like 'Day 83'. Fix: keep bundled.cluster and bundled.shows, and merge only state, ticketsSold and the deadlines from chain per show; or decide `live` from `!ownRun`, not from run.cluster

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:59-71: the show is looked up in fetchLiveTour(r.band.authority), where r is the bundled demo run, so the page for a show the band booked itself has a truncated address as its h1, with no city, no venue name, no day and no replacement links. Fix: once acct loads, call fetchLiveTour(acct.bandAuthority.toBase58()) and find the show there

packages/web/src/lib/book.ts:160,180-183: on resume, `now` is taken afresh and every missing show's date becomes newNow + SALES + day*2. chain-live.ts:85 then numbers days from the earliest date, so shows added a few minutes later read 'Day 151' and sort after the others. Fix: on resume, derive the base from an existing show, base = existing.date - SHOW_AFTER - SALES*60 - (its planned day - plan[0].day)*DEMO_DAY_SEC, with the planned day matched by venuePubkey

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:115-122: TicketBought, ShowConfirmed, ShowCancelled, TicketRefunded, ShowSettled and ShowRejected never say which show, so a 9-show tour's feed repeats 'Threshold met (10/20): show confirmed.' with no city. Fix: pass a show->city map (fetchShowEvents already has the show list; take the cities from fetchLiveTour) and prefix the city to the text

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:205-212 with components/Feed.tsx:61,98: fetchShowEvents catches every RPC failure and returns [], so on a rate-limited devnet Feed shows the empty text 'Your shows are booked; nothing else has happened yet' next to cards showing tickets sold and a confirmed show (also visible in 7-booked-dashboard.png). Fix: throw, or return a flag, when no show's signatures could be read, and make the empty text conditional on the shows having no sales

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:25,63-66: the partial-booking state lives only in React state; after a reload, 'Book this tour' opens a second tour and the half-booked one stays on the dashboard as the latest. Fix: on plan, check whether the toursCreated-1 tour has fewer shows than the plan and offer to finish it

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:78,85-87: after a resume, booked.shows holds only the newly added shows ('2 shows are booked' for a 9-show tour); 'receipt on Solana' links to the tour account, not a transaction; BookedTour.signatures is unused. Fix: count every show of the tour and list a tx link for each signature

packages/web/src/components/ShowCard.tsx:35,50 and app/show/page.tsx:120,165-169: 'Day 1 · Nov 3' still sits beside 'deadline 29m 54s' / 'show 1h 0m' with no demo-clock cue. Fix: add a muted 'demo clock' note or a title tooltip saying the dates are the planned tour days and the timers are real

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:192-202: a wallet that holds a ticket gets no buy control and no reason (one Ticket PDA per wallet per show). Fix: add 'One purchase per wallet per show' under the holding line

packages/web/src/app/globals.css:569: .stepper is repeat(6, 1fr), but the live stepper (page.tsx:201-208) has 5 steps, leaving an empty sixth column (visible in 7-booked-dashboard.png). Fix: set gridTemplateColumns from steps.length, or use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(0,1fr))

packages/web/src/app/globals.css:555-557: the 'wait' attention dot is the brand green, so 'shows wait for their venue' reads as good news and uses green decoratively. Fix: use --text-muted or --info for wait

packages/web/src/app/venues/page.tsx:162: at 390px every city card is still fully expanded (phone-venues.png is 15,027 px tall). Fix: collapse city cards on phone by default, or default the list to the nearest country

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:44,52,125: an invalid ?address= reads as 'Could not reach the network (Invalid public key input)'. Fix: validate it with a try/new PublicKey before fetching and say 'Not a show address'

packages/web/src/app/feed/page.tsx:27-29: when fetchLiveTour fails, shows stays undefined and the page says 'Reading your tour…' forever. Fix: keep an error state and show the retry note the dashboard uses
packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:39: a profile read error still shows a bare 'Waiting for devnet…' with no detail or retry button

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:202-214,231: the per-signature 'slot order' is computed and never used. Events from different transactions in the same second are ordered by decode id, which follows newest-first signature order, so they come out reversed. Fix: sort by (blockTime, slot), using the slot from getSignaturesForAddress
packages/web/src/lib/format.ts:28-29: two stacked doc comments on dayLabel; the first belongs to demoDate
packages/web/src/app/globals.css:22: SpotifyMixUI/CircularSp are not shipped, so pages render in Helvetica/Arial. Fix: load a close open font (e.g. Figtree via next/font) as the first fallback

qa/src/ui-bot.ts:347-366: the booked-tour check has no show-page shot, no phone shot of the populated dashboard and no feed fixture: the fake devnet returns no signatures, so the bot accepts a feed that contradicts the cards. Fix: add /show?address=<Berlin> desktop and phone shots, plus one fake signature with a ShowConfirmed log
